title: Initial product boundary
proposal: Receiver-side monitoring platform with separate CAN/perception tracks
revisit_trigger: Confirm actual operator and target hardware.

title: External benchmark
proposal: D02 versus D03 after sample audit
revisit_trigger: Revisit if required fields or data rights fail.

title: Model and feature selection
revisit_trigger: Choose only after eligible comparisons; revalidate new domains.

title: Offline evidence architecture
proposal: Durable incident/outbox; asynchronous explanation and anchoring
revisit_trigger: Revisit when load, device storage or retention changes.

title: Blockchain platform
proposal: Compare signed log, Fabric variants and Besu QBFT
revisit_trigger: Independent participants and fault model are prerequisites.

title: Simulator selection
proposal: MOSAIC versus Veins spike; CARLA and PC5 models conditional
revisit_trigger: Revisit if radio profile, sensor needs or host compatibility changes.

title: Backend and GUI technology
proposal: Python service boundary; FastAPI and separate web client candidates

title: Separate repository for the rebuild
proposal: New private repo mohamed2hamdoun/roadtrust; hackathon code stays in Cyberthorn-project
revisit_trigger: Publishing, outside collaborators, or a single-history requirement

title: Monorepo, folders added per phase
proposal: One repo: docs, tools, core, sim, chain, web, deploy; each folder created when its phase starts
revisit_trigger: A part gets its own owner or release cycle, or unrelated CI becomes costly

title: One branch and PR per plan step
proposal: Branch p<phase>/<step>-<slug> per step, draft PR into main, merge commits so recorded hashes survive
revisit_trigger: PR overhead slows work, or a second developer joins

title: Python 3.12 with uv, root project, code in core/
proposal: requires-python ==3.12.*; uv lockfile; hatchling builds core/roadtrust
revisit_trigger: Dependency lacks 3.12 wheels, 3.12 nears EOL, or a second Python package appears

title: Ruff, strict mypy, pre-commit, Hypothesis
proposal: Ruff lint+format, mypy strict on core and tools, local pre-commit hooks via uv, Hypothesis for property tests
revisit_trigger: Untypeable dependency, slow commits, or editor change

title: GitHub Actions CI on every pull request
proposal: Locked sync, ruff, mypy, pytest and registry validator on ubuntu-latest; actions pinned by commit hash
revisit_trigger: New toolchain folders, low Actions minutes, or new major action versions

title: Every change carries a checked record
proposal: ADR08-13 format; validator checks sections, CR index, registered ADRs and cited commits; commit messages must name ADR/CR; PR template
revisit_trigger: Record friction slows work, a second contributor joins, or empty records pass

title: Internal disk with 60 GB cap, data outside repo, CARLA on lab GPU
proposal: ROADTRUST_DATA_DIR (default ~/roadtrust-data) via roadtrust.paths.data_dir(), guarded against repo paths; move to SSD past 60 GB
revisit_trigger: Data over 60 GB, free space under 40 GB, RAM limits, or lab access changes

title: Two deployment profiles (RSU, OBU), two user roles, monitoring only
proposal: Shared core with rsu/obu profiles; optional OBU ego-sensor input; OBU reports plus lab-only driver warning; one role-based app for operators and researchers; replay then lab bench
revisit_trigger: No OBU ego data available, driver budget unreachable, field-pilot offer, or capacity for two profiles lost
